sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

reply.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Without movement from your side we cannot move either.

Our current offer remains a price of €438.21 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days under our standard corporate pricing guidelines. 

We require your formal response regarding these terms to determine the next steps in our process.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – counterproposal for part:350020
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for  at €438.21. To secure a stable supply of part:350020 we would rather commit for two years than renew for only twelve months.

For a 24-month framework at 4580 pcs/year (fc:350020@2026-09), please quote €432.00 per unit at 30 days net; for 36 months we could support €428.50.

Your on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3) matters to us, so please confirm the 49-day lead time holds from 2027.

Could you also send a brief cost breakdown, so we can align your price with our internal review?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.subject: Framework renewal part:350020 - term proposal
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for offer:70530-2. We accept your EUR 432.00 unit price and will hold a steady 4580 pcs per year (fc:350020@2026-09) across the term.

Since price is fixed until late 2027, may we align the payment term instead? Our standard is 60 days net, so please consider 60 days on a 24-month framework. If you prefer longer planning security, we can commit to a 36-month framework and would ask for 90 days net in return.

Could you also confirm the 49-day lead time holds from 2027-01-01, so our scheduling stays firm?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer

move.subject: Offer:70530-5 — 36-month framework and payment alignment
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for offer:70530-5. We remain committed to a steady 4580 pcs per year (fc:350020@2026-09) for part:350020.

Since framework ctr:4600070530 runs to 2026-12-31, we would like to conclude promptly and can offer longer planning security in return.

For a 36-month term, may we align payment at 60 days net at the unchanged EUR 432.00 per unit? If 45 days net is more workable, we would equally sign at EUR 432.00, 45 days net, over 36 months.

Could you also share a short cost breakdown behind the EUR 432.00, so we can find a structure that works for both sides?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
